Do you price match or honor a price drop after purchase?

Yes, we can honor a price drop after purchase in many cases. If your order was placed within 30 days and the exact item is currently in stock at the lower price, we can process a price adjustment for the difference back to your original payment method. Shipping charges are not included in that adjustment.

If you want me to check a specific order, send your order number or the email used at checkout and I’ll look into it. 🖤
